call_plan.phase_1: C (date-aware prompt) on DA-01..DA-08, one generation request each (8)
call_plan.phase_2: at most 1 retry of a C request that failed with a timeout/server error
call_plan.phase_3: B (production prompt) on ['DA-01', 'DA-06'] in that order with the remaining budget
stop_rules: quota / rate-limit / auth / model-not-found / budget error: stop (quota or rate limit may be resumed later inside the same 10-request budget)
more than 1 timeout/server error: stop for good
a request that fails for any other reason (bad JSON, truncated, blocked) is final and is scored fail-closed; it is not retried
